metadata.title: ज़ायका गंगा किनारे वाला - Ganga Utsav 2020
metadata.description:
The longest and the holiest river of India, Ganga with its grand and incredible course has nurtured civilizations and our souls. Hence on the occasion of Ganga Utsav 2020 organised by National Mission For Clean Ganga (Namami Gange)  we bring you the story of the flavours and tastes that have evolved across some of the major cities situated on its course. This includes Rishikesh, Haridwar, Varanasi, Allahabad, Patna and Kolkata. Ganga utsav 2020 is a cultural and educational festival to celebrate the glory of the holy river. 

Join Anubhav Sapra as he takes you down the memory lane and introduces you to some of the amazing gastronomic experiences gathered at these places.
